tutorial.title: How to play Termo
tutorial.intro: Find the hidden {length}-letter word. Type a word and press Enter: every letter shows how close you got.
tutorial.right: The letter {letter} is in the word and in the right place.
tutorial.place: The letter {letter} is in the word, but in another position.
tutorial.wrong: The letter {letter} is not in the word.
tutorial.accents: Accents and the cedilla are not typed. The game adds them, and they do not count.
tutorial.repeats: A word can repeat a letter.
tutorial.keyboard: The erase key removes one letter, Clear empties the row. Tap a tile to move the cursor.
tutorial.modes: Termo is 1 word in 6 guesses. Dueto is 2 words at once in 7, and Quarteto is 4 in 9. Every guess counts for all of them.
tutorial.controls: Hint reveals one letter in its place. Reveal shows the answer and ends the game.
